items.familyEn: Right Wing — Finish Quickly Against the Empty Opponent Goal
items.mainRisk: Opponent empty-goal situation uses the same “finish the available side the goalkeeper leaves” answer template as filled-goal scenarios — there is no goalkeeper to leave a side.
items.tacticalRealism: Empty opponent goal is real, but the optimal answer and explanation ignore that the goal is empty and recycle generic GK-side finishing language.
items.rwSpecificity: YES — wing transition to empty goal is RW-relevant, but teaching content is destroyed by the wrong answer frame.
items.geometry: Lane is free; no defender between RW and goal. Clear. The failure is answer/GK logic, not spacing.
items.goalkeeperLogic: FAIL — answer refers to “available side of goal” from GK when opponent GK is not in goal.

items.perception: NO — situation already states free path and empty goal; question restates freedom.

en.situation: Yoat trail 23:22 at 46. minutes. Protivnički goalkeeper kasni s povratkom nakon izmjene, a njihov goal je prazan. Imaš čist put do linije šest metara, ali svaki dodatni korak daje goalkeeperat vrijeme da uđe at goal.
en.question: Their goal is empty and you are free on the wing — what do you do?
en.A: Take off immediately and finish from the available side of goal
en.B: Return the ball only if the defender closes the take-off before you jump
en.C: Force the first shot without checking the defender’s coverage
en.D: Play a blind long pass across the covered defence
en.correct: Take off immediately and finish from the available side of goal
en.explanation: Read the concrete geometry: defender position, passing lane, take-off space, and goalkeeper or turnover risk. The decision must follow that signal, not the numerical label alone.

hr.B: Utrči unutra tek nakon što igrač s loptom veže braniča ispred tebe
hr.C: Forsiraj prvu akciju bez čitanja pokrivanja braniča
hr.D: Baci slijepo dugo dodavanje preko pokrivene obrane
hr.correct: Ostani široko desno i ponudi sigurno sljedeće dodavanje za pozicijski napad
hr.explanation: Čitaj konkretnu geometriju: položaj braniča, liniju dodavanja, prostor za odraz te položaj vratara ili rizik gubitka lopte. Odluka slijedi taj signal, ne samo brojčanu oznaku.

de.situation: Ihr führt 14:13 u 28. Minute. Prvi val je usporio jer su dva braniča u povratku već na liniji šest metara; jedan stoji između tebe i lopte, drugi je u sredini uz pivota. Nema više brojčane prednosti, a Abwehr se postavlja u 6:0. Još si visoko desno i rechte Rückraumspieler može sigurno nastaviti napad ako mu ostaneš kao široka opcija.
de.question: Der Vorteil der ersten Welle ist weg — was tust du rechts?
de.A: Rechts breit bleiben und den sicheren nächsten Pass für den Positionsangriff anbieten
de.B: Erst nach innen schneiden, wenn der Ballführer den Verteidiger vor dir bindet
de.C: Den ersten Wurf ohne Lesen der Verteidigung erzwingen
de.D: Einen blinden langen Pass über die gedeckte Abwehr werfen
de.correct: Rechts breit bleiben und den sicheren nächsten Pass für den Positionsangriff anbieten
de.explanation: Lies die konkrete Geometrie: Verteidigerposition, Passlinie, Absprungraum sowie Torhüter- oder Ballverlustrisiko. Die Entscheidung folgt diesem Signal, nicht allein der Zahlensituation.

items.familyEn: Right Wing — Hold Second-Wave Width, Not a Late Cut
items.mainRisk: Second-wave width hold duplicates 906 and 877 with same A/B/C/D.
items.geometry: OK — wing defender back, half on pivot.

hrLanguage.whyWrong: “upotrebljivim” is bureaucratic; coaches say “da napad ostane živ / da imamo širinu”.

en.situation: Yoat lead 16:15 at 32. minutes. Drugi val dolazi prema postavljenoj 6:0, a srednji vanjski ima ballt na devet metara. Krilni branič se vratio at kut, dok polubranitelj stoji uz pivota i zatvara prostor izmeđat njih. Ako sada utrčiš prema sredini, dovodiš još jednog napadača at isti zbijeni dio obrane; ostajući uz aut-linijat prisiljavaš krilnog braniča da ostane wide.
en.question: Second wave arrives as the defence sets — what keeps the attack usable?
en.A: Stay wide on the right and offer the safe next pass into the set attack
en.B: Cut inside only after the ball carrier fixes the defender in front of you
en.C: Force the first shot without checking the defender’s coverage
en.D: Play a blind long pass across the covered defence
en.correct: Stay wide on the right and offer the safe next pass into the set attack
en.explanation: Read the concrete geometry: defender position, passing lane, take-off space, and goalkeeper or turnover risk. The decision must follow that signal, not the numerical label alone.

hr.question: Drugi val stiže dok se obrana postavlja — što drži napad upotrebljivim?

de.question: Die zweite Welle kommt während die Abwehr steht — was hält den Angriff spielbar?
de.A: Rechts breit bleiben und den sicheren nächsten Pass für den Positionsangriff anbieten

de.C: Den ersten Wurf ohne Lesen der Verteidigung erzwingen
de.D: Einen blinden langen Pass über die gedeckte Abwehr werfen

items.familyEn: Right Wing — 6v5: Finish When You Are Free and Help Is Late
items.mainRisk: Approved-pilot descendant, but question/answer are reading-comprehension: situation already says alone + >2m; A restates that.
items.tacticalRealism: Core idea is sound (free wing in 6v5).

hrLanguage.quote: Igrač više pomaže stvoriti ovu sliku — odluka dolazi iz toga što si sam.
hrLanguage.whyWrong: Meta-commentary (“ova slika”) is trainer-manual tone, not match language; also telegraphs the answer.

items.aVsB: B is decent emergency outlet; main issue is Q/A spoiling.
items.perception: NO — distances are given, not discovered.

en.situation: You lead 21:20 at 41' in a 6v5 after their exclusion. The right back has pulled two defenders. You receive alone near the sideline; the nearest recovering defender is still more than two metres from your take-off spot and cannot contest it. The goalkeeper stays deep on the goal line. Another full swing to the other side would give the defence time to recover to your corner. The player-up helps create this picture — the decision itself comes from you being free.
en.question: Why should you finish from this catch?
en.A: Because you are alone and the nearest defender is too far to contest your take-off
en.B: Short pass to the right back only if a defender jumps you before you control the catch
en.C: Swing to the other side again to keep circulating while they recover to your corner
en.D: Force a pass into the crowded pivot area instead of using the free wing finish
en.correct: Because you are alone and the nearest defender is too far to contest your take-off
en.explanation: Cue: alone near the sideline, nearest recovering defender more than two metres from your take-off, goalkeeper deep. Finish now. 6v5 helps create the picture; freedom and late help decide it. Another swing (C) gives them recovery time.

hr.situation: Vodite 21:20 u 41. minuti u igraču više 6 na 5 nakon njihovog isključenja. Desni vanjski povukao je dva braniča. Primaš sam blizu aut-linije; najbliži branič u povratku još je više od dva metra od mjesta tvog odraza i ne može ga ometati. Vratar ostaje duboko na golu. Još jedan puni prelazak lopte na drugu stranu dao bi obrani vremena da se vrati u tvoj kut. Igrač više pomaže stvoriti ovu sliku — odluka dolazi iz toga što si sam.
hr.question: Zašto trebaš završiti s ovog prijema?
hr.A: Jer si sam i najbliži branič je predaleko da ometa tvoj odraz
hr.B: Kratko dodavanje desnom vanjskom samo ako te branič skoči prije nego primiš loptu pod kontrolom
hr.C: Ponovno prebaci na drugu stranu da nastaviš cirkulaciju dok se oni vraćaju u tvoj kut
hr.D: Forsiraj dodavanje u zbijeni prostor pivota umjesto slobodnog krilnog završetka
hr.correct: Jer si sam i najbliži branič je predaleko da ometa tvoj odraz
hr.explanation: Signal: sam blizu aut-linije, najbliži branič u povratku više od dva metra od odraza, vratar duboko. Završi sada. 6 na 5 pomaže stvoriti sliku; sloboda i kasna pomoć odlučuju. Još jedan prelazak (C) daje im vrijeme za povratak.

de.situation: Ihr führt 21:20 in Minute 41 im Überzahl 6 gegen 5 nach ihrer Zeitstrafe. Der rechte Rückraum hat zwei Verteidiger gezogen. Du fängst allein nahe der Seitenlinie; der nächste zurückkommende Verteidiger ist noch mehr als zwei Meter von deinem Absprungpunkt und kann ihn nicht stören. Der Torhüter bleibt tief auf der Torlinie. Ein weiterer voller Seitenwechsel gäbe der Abwehr Zeit zurück in deine Ecke. Die Überzahl hilft dieses Bild zu schaffen — die Entscheidung kommt daraus dass du frei bist.
de.question: Warum solltest du aus diesem Fang abschließen?
de.A: Weil du allein bist und der nächste Verteidiger zu weit ist um deinen Absprung zu stören
de.B: Kurzer Pass auf den rechten Rückraum nur wenn ein Verteidiger dich anspringt bevor du den Fang kontrollierst
de.C: Nochmal auf die andere Seite schieben und weiter zirkulieren während sie in deine Ecke zurückkehren
de.D: Pass in den verdichteten Kreisraum erzwingen statt des freien Flügelabschlusses
de.correct: Weil du allein bist und der nächste Verteidiger zu weit ist um deinen Absprung zu stören
de.explanation: Signal: allein nahe der Seitenlinie, nächster Zurückkommender mehr als zwei Meter vom Absprung, Torhüter tief. Jetzt abschließen. 6 gegen 5 hilft das Bild; Freiheit und späte Hilfe entscheiden. Weiterer Seitenwechsel (C) schenkt Rückkehrzeit.

items.familyEn: Right Wing — Defence: When Their Wing Stays High, Do Not Chase Blindly
items.mainRisk: 1:5 high-wing defence is a legitimate Expert/Advanced RW defensive read, but HR has an appended geometry patch glued without punctuation and some awkward wording.
items.rwSpecificity: YES — wing depth vs high LW in 1:5.
items.geometry: Mostly clear; “middle depth” is a bit abstract but coach-understandable.

hrLanguage.quote: iznenadno dugo dodavanje te prelazi Čitaj krilnog braniča i liniju šest metara prije odluke.
hrLanguage.whyWrong: Programmatic patch concatenated without period/space logic; “Čitaj krilnog braniča…” is unnatural bolted-on instruction. Also “mamac” in explanation is OK-ish but “jurnjave u prazan prostor” is slightly comic.

items.aVsB: A vs B is actually one of the better defensive pairs if language is fixed.
items.perception: YES — must read high wing vs ball side.
items.duplicationRisk: Low vs other defence items; distinct from handover family.

en.situation: Tied 16:16 at 33' in a 1:5. You defend the right wing. Their left wing stays unusually high near the half-way line while the ball is on the far side. If you chase him high into empty space, you leave the deep corner behind you for a long diagonal. If you drop too deep with no vision on him, a sudden long pass beats you.
en.question: How do you handle their high wing from your side?
en.A: Hold a middle depth with vision on him and the ball — deny the deep corner without chasing into empty space
en.B: Step higher only when the ball is already traveling toward him and you can still recover the corner
en.C: Chase him to the half-way line and leave the corner empty
en.D: Turn your back to the ball and only watch their wing
en.correct: Hold a middle depth with vision on him and the ball — deny the deep corner without chasing into empty space
en.explanation: Cue: 1:5, opposing wing high, ball far side. Hold middle depth with vision; do not chase into empty space. Higher step (B) only when the pass is already traveling.

hr.situation: Neriješeno je 16:16 u 33. minuti u 1:5. Braniš desno krilo. Njihovo lijevo krilo ostaje neuobičajeno visoko blizu polovice dok je lopta na drugoj strani. Ako ga juriš visoko u prazan prostor, ostavljaš duboki kut iza sebe za dugu dijagonalu. Ako padneš preduboko bez pogleda na njega, iznenadno dugo dodavanje te prelazi Čitaj krilnog braniča i liniju šest metara prije odluke.
hr.question: Kako rješavaš njihovo visoko krilo sa svoje strane?
hr.A: Drži srednju dubinu s pogledom na njega i loptu — zatvori duboki kut bez jurnjave u prazan prostor
hr.B: Idi više samo kad lopta već ide prema njemu i još možeš stići u kut
hr.C: Juri ga do polovice i ostavi kut prazan
hr.D: Okreni leđa lopti i samo gledaj njihovo krilo
hr.correct: Drži srednju dubinu s pogledom na njega i loptu — zatvori duboki kut bez jurnjave u prazan prostor
hr.explanation: Signal: 1:5, protivničko krilo visoko, lopta na drugoj strani. Drži srednju dubinu s pogledom; ne juri u prazan prostor. Viši korak (B) samo kad dodavanje već ide.

de.situation: Unentschieden 16:16 in Minute 33 in einer 1:5. Du verteidigst Rechtsaußen. Ihr Linksaußen bleibt ungewöhnlich hoch nahe der Mittellinie während der Ball auf der anderen Seite ist. Jagen Sie ihn hoch in den leeren Raum, lässt du die tiefe Ecke hinter dir für die lange Diagonale. Fällst du zu tief ohne Sicht auf ihn, schlägt dich ein plötzlicher langer Pass.
de.question: Wie löst du ihren hohen Flügel von deiner Seite?
de.A: Mittlere Tiefe mit Sicht auf ihn und den Ball — tiefe Ecke sichern ohne in den leeren Raum zu jagen
de.B: Nur höher gehen wenn der Ball schon zu ihm unterwegs ist und du die Ecke noch erreichst
de.C: Ihn bis zur Mittellinie jagen und die Ecke leer lassen
de.D: Dem Ball den Rücken drehen und nur ihren Flügel beobachten
de.correct: Mittlere Tiefe mit Sicht auf ihn und den Ball — tiefe Ecke sichern ohne in den leeren Raum zu jagen
de.explanation: Signal: 1:5, Gegnerflügel hoch, Ball andere Seite. Mittlere Tiefe mit Sicht; nicht in den leeren Raum jagen. Höherer Schritt (B) nur wenn der Pass schon unterwegs ist.
